brief.headline: Revenue rose 38.8% to 59721, driven by a 28.4% increase in users and a 5% lift in conversion rate, while India outperformed and Canada lagged.
executive_summary: Total revenue was 59721, up 38.8% from 43042; transactions were 865, up 34.3% from 644.
Sessions were 38729, up 24.6%; users were 31498, up 28.4%; conversion rate was 1.99, up 5% from 1.9.
India revenue was 7512, up 117.9%, with a gap_vs_total_pts of 79.1; Canada revenue was 4323, down 5.2%, with revenue per session at 1.47, down 21.2%.
Product view to add to cart remains the biggest funnel leak at 33.04, down 1.8% from 33.65.

what_changed.title: Total revenue and transactions increased
what_changed.detail: Revenue was 59721, up 38.8% from 43042; transactions were 865, up 34.3% from 644; users were 31498, up 28.4% from 24534.

what_changed.title: India outperformed the total
what_changed.detail: India revenue was 7512, up 117.9% from 3448, with gap_vs_total_pts of 79.1; India revenue per session was 2.06, up 72.1% from 1.2, with gap_vs_total_pts of 60.7.

what_changed.title: Canada lagged the total
what_changed.detail: Canada revenue was 4323, down 5.2% from 4561, while sessions were up 20.3%; Canada revenue per session was 1.47, down 21.2% from 1.87, with gap_vs_total_pts of -32.6.

what_changed.title: Checkout improved but product-to-cart remains the biggest leak
what_changed.detail: Product view to add to cart was 33.04, down 1.8% from 33.65; add to cart to checkout was 58.25, up 7.5%; checkout to purchase was 48.8, up 17.4%.

likely_drivers: No calendar event is listed for this week; the previous week included Cyber Monday, so the increase is likely not a listed-event spike.
India revenue and revenue per session moved far above the total, consistent with a country-specific demand increase.
Canada sessions rose 20.3% but revenue fell 5.2%, consistent with weaker monetization in that segment.
risks: If Canada revenue per session stays at 1.47 while the total is 1.54, Canada could continue to drag total growth.
If the product view to add to cart step stays at 33.04, additional traffic may not convert into carts.
Source and campaign data quality issues could lead to decisions based on incomplete channel attribution.

actions.action: Investigate and document what is driving the India revenue increase, then assess whether the same levers can be applied to other underperforming markets.
actions.why: India revenue was 7512, up 117.9% from 3448, with gap_vs_total_pts of 79.1, far above the total 38.8% increase.
actions.evidence: India revenue 7512 vs 3448, change_pct 117.9, gap_vs_total_pts 79.1; India revenue_per_session 2.06 vs 1.2, change_pct 72.1, gap_vs_total_pts 60.7

actions.action: Review Canada product pages and checkout flow to identify why sessions up 20.3% did not translate into revenue growth.
actions.why: Canada revenue was 4323, down 5.2% from 4561, while sessions were up 20.3%; revenue per session was 1.47, down 21.2% from 1.87, with gap_vs_total_pts of -32.6.
actions.evidence: Canada revenue 4323 vs 4561, change_pct -5.2; sessions_change_pct 20.3; revenue_per_session 1.47 vs 1.87, change_pct -21.2, gap_vs_total_pts -32.6

actions.action: Run a CRO test on the product view to add to cart step, which is the biggest funnel leak.
actions.why: Product view to add to cart was 33.04, down 1.8% from 33.65, and is flagged as the biggest leak in the funnel.
actions.evidence: Product view to add to cart 33.04 vs 33.65, change_pct -1.8, change_points -0.62; flagged as biggest_leak

data_caveats: This is Google's public obfuscated GA4 sample dataset (Google Merchandise Store), not a real client.
Session-level source is available for only 73.5% of sessions; 24.4% of source rows are unknown or obfuscated. Treat source breakdowns with caution.
Channels and campaigns include obfuscated placeholders such as <Other> and (data deleted); no actions should be taken on those segments.
